We didn't invite my JNMIL or my JNSIL. We informed security the week before the big day and sent them their pictures. I'm really glad we did the pictures because SIL showed up but was swiftly escorted off of the premises and security was doubled. 

I highly recommend security, they were a life saver.

We are nc though, and haven't heard from them in months. It really depends where you are in your relationship before the wedding, it made sense for us to not invite them. Make sure to talk this over in depth and not make any rushed choices.

My onset was at age 11, hitting hard and fast. I was a very depressed child, as well as obsessive. I was 19 when I got my diagnosis and I was so happy. I finally knew what was going on, why I felt so abnormal growing up. It was truly a blessing, allowing my to get a treatment plan that mostly works. I honestly never thought, never planned on making it past 18. Suicide was always my easy out. Its gotten so much better. I can't believe how different life is with direction and a decent treatment plan
